page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data.

A key technical constraint of the ecs.s3.large instance is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets. Hardware flags for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI) are unavailable. Additionally, virtualization extensions and security features like Total Memory Encryption (TME) are not supported. These limitations restrict the instance's performance in vector-heavy calculations, machine learning inference, and hardware-accelerated encryption tasks.

From a resource-allocation perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-focused option for entry-level workloads. Because it provides dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading, it offers predictable compute performance for tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. This profile is suitable for lightweight web serving, basic microservices, CI/CD build agents, and simple utility scripting where advanced instruction sets and local storage are not required.
